verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so overriding low-level runtime settings such as memory locking or mmap is a fair question for it. The pack has no evidence of these controls: it covers bindings, model conversion, benchmarking and OpenAI-compatible APIs, but no mlock, mmap or other low-level engine knobs. Vendoring llama.cpp (comm-14) is an underlying building block, not a documented override this product exposes.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
